title: CR60011: Cryofuel Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Properties of Hydrocarbon Mixtures-equations of state, The Law of Corresponding
States, transport properties. Liquefied Petroleum Gas - properties, production
and storage. Natural Gas-composition, source and pretreatment. Liquefaction of
natural gas - simple cascade, mixed refrigerant and turbine expansion cycles,
Ocean transport of LNG membrane and self-supporting tanks. Storage of LNG.
Applications of NG and LNG and safety aspects; Hydrogen - properties,
production and pretreatment - Liquefaction of hydrogen - Linde, Claude and
helium - hydrogen condensing cycles, Ortho-para conversion. Storage and
handling of liquefied hydrogen - applications of hydrogen, and its safety.
